title: Urgent Dispatch
description: Elder Moor's watch has turned back the supply column meant for Thornfield's garrison - bad axle, worse road - and someone needs to carry word ahead before Thornfield's captain plans a week around grain that isn't coming. The seal is wax, not paper folded twice; this one is meant to be believed on sight.

objectives.description: Get the sealed dispatch into Thornfield's captain's own hand

notes: Threat: Thornfield's garrison is expecting a supply column that has been turned back and may run short before it knows. Giver motive: Elder Moor's watch relays the account garrison-to-garrison because a written warning beats a late wagon as the first sign of trouble. Refusal/consequence stated in prose only - no flag or timer wired, since this file has no choice_consequences to extend.
